qa: App Fusion is possible with the following combinations. ●[Gatchmon] with [Navimon] link card ●[Gatchmon] with [Tweetmon] link card ●[Navimon] with [Gatchmon] link card ●[Navimon] with [Tweetmon] link card ●[Tweetmon] with [Gatchmon] link card ●[Tweetmon] with [Navimon] link card
extracted.special_digivolution_condition: [App Fusion] [Gatchmon] & [Navimon] & [Tweetmon]: Cost 0 If 2 such cards are linked together, stack the link card on top and digivolve.

text_sections.label: Special Digivolution Condition
text_sections.text: [App Fusion] [Gatchmon] & [Navimon] & [Tweetmon]: Cost 0 If 2 such cards are linked together, stack the link card on top and digivolve.

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: ＜Raid＞ [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] You may link 1 Digimon card with the [Social], [Navi] or [Tool] trait from your hand or this Digimon's digivolution cards to this Digimon with the link cost reduced by 2.

text_sections.label: Link Condition
text_sections.text: ＜Link＞ [Appmon] trait: Cost 2 (Plug this card from the hand or battle area sideways into the specified Digimon in the battle area.)

text_sections.label: Link Effect
text_sections.text: [When Linking] Return 1 of your opponent's 5000 DP or lower Digimon to the bottom of the deck.
